name: Wo Fei Shengxian
source:
Set in an alternate history, this narrative-driven game follows the journey of a male protagonist who rises from a humble study master's son to a powerful figure shaping the fate of the world. The story centers around the protagonist and three female leads, exploring their intricate love-hate relationships and the ups and downs of life. Supporting characters serve primarily as plot devices.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3915200]Steam[/url]]
